authority: original real-product evaluation prompt plus continuation instruction

items.A1: User objective, domain semantics, scope and constraints understood
items.A2: Project understanding grounded in actual code, data and execution
items.A3: Verifiable decomposition with I/O, dependencies, interfaces, state and acceptance
items.A4: Traceability across requirements, versions, changes, implementation, tests and evidence
items.B1: Core functionality and required branches complete
items.B2: Parameters, defaults, formats, units, media timeline and subtitle details correct
items.B3: Empty, boundary and invalid inputs handled according to public contract
items.B4: Local state, controls, cancellation and repetition complete without undisclosed placeholders
items.C1: GUI intent reaches backend with correct object, account and version
items.C2: Saved data survives refresh and reopening
items.C3: Tasks/data correspond to actual files or remote objects and correct versions
items.C4: Results return to GUI with correct state and object isolation
items.D1: Candidate-authored tests map to actual requirements
items.D2: Candidate assertions verify business end states, not merely mocked calls or exit codes
items.D3: Candidate tests reject valid representative erroneous variants
items.D4: Reproducible regression and accurate PASS/FAIL/SKIP/BLOCKED reporting tied to candidate version
items.E1: Independent operator finds entry and controls using permitted user instructions
items.E2: GUI completes workflow without undisclosed API/database/background substitution
items.E3: Feedback, errors, progress, layout and state understandable
items.E4: Workflow completes within frozen operation burden; detours and remediation recorded
items.F1: Required interruption, retry or uncertain remote result handled without forbidden effects
items.F2: Saved data and existing workflows retained; required migration/compatibility fulfilled
items.F3: Installation, launch and use reproducible in specified environment
items.F4: Logs, diagnostics, instructions, known limitations and handoff support maintenance

levels.0: Observed missing, wrong or unusable; not a substitute for untested
levels.1: Isolated demonstration or fragments; major obligations absent
levels.2: Partial or ideal path; important gaps or undisclosed assistance
levels.3: Core and usual specified requirements verified; explicit noncritical gaps
levels.4: All frozen obligations independently evidenced, including specified boundaries and regression

gates.G4: No critical data loss, unauthorized/wrong-account publishing or forbidden duplicates

missing_evidence: Keep null/UNTESTED; retain all weights; report confirmed contribution, evaluated weight, pending weight and full-score interval. Never normalize assessed items.
precedence: Contamination separate; known necessary-condition failure => NOT_DELIVERABLE with missing items; no known failure but incomplete necessary evidence => UNVERIFIED; only all conditions passed => AUTONOMOUS_DELIVERABLE
